title: Jack Stewart's wingman saw object turn and follow

tellings.quote: said, "Yeah, dude. That thing turned around and followed you."

there's another instance down in New Orleans where uh an object with the same description shot past the cockpit, initially thought it was a balloon until his wingman noticed that it turned and chased the jet
tellings.difference: Places it near New Orleans and adds that the object shot past the cockpit and was first taken for a balloon. The pilot is not named.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of a pilot's wingman seeing an object turn around and follow the jet, the Jack Stewart incident that Graves relays.

as_told.title: Object chases a jet near New Orleans

plain: A Navy pilot saw an object shoot past his cockpit and took it for a balloon, but his wingman saw it turn around and chase the jet, and told him, "Yeah, dude. That thing turned around and followed you." The former Navy fighter pilot Ryan Graves tells this without naming the pilot and places it near New Orleans. The former Pentagon official and columnist Marik von Rennenkampff tells it as the story of a pilot named Jack Stewart. If it is true, the object was no balloon, because a balloon cannot change course to follow a jet.
